properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-03, in chat: "All six: not fixed". The change touched this defect's subject but did not fix it, and the defect stays open. Measured reason: the usage ledger names a caller only from the initialize handshake, so a stateless call is recorded as `rmcp`. #656 adds a refusal class to the ledger; it does not change how a caller is named.
